main_text.l: Quare sicut in momento lumen per tota per-
spicui substantiam, amoto opaco, diffunditur:
ita econtrà opaco interposito, in momento rur-
sus evanescit, ac fiunt Tenebrae: quae respectu
corporis opaci, quod suà interpositione inter lu-
cem & perspicuum illas efficit, umbra dicuntur.
Color est qualitas ostensiva simplex, ex opaci
crassi pluris & perspicui paucioris coalitione e-
manans, corpus coloratum in perspicuo illumi-
nato tantum modo visibile exhibens.
Color est extremus, vel medius.
Extremus color est, qui multum de suorum prin-
cipiorum altero, perspicuo aut opaco, participat.
Estq; albor & nigredo.
Albor est color extremus, multum perspicui
habens.
Quapropter hoc colore praedita corpora in
perspicuo illuminato juxta alia collocata, ipsa
quoq; aliquid luminis conferunt, maximeq; præ[?]
aliis fiunt visibilia.
Nigredo est color extremus, multum opaci ob-
tinens.
Hic igitur color non collustrat alia corpora, ut
albor: sed potius obscurat, corpus q; nigrum mi-
nus visibile efficit.
Medius color est, qui de utroq; extremo parti-
cipat.
Et est exacte medius, aut non-exacte.
Exacte medius est Rubor: ex æquali contempera-
tio-

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout, as required. Uncertain readings: "præ[?]" (the printed abbreviation after "maximeq;" is unclear), and "æquali" (the word before "contemperatio" is hard to read). Italics on "Color", "Albor", "Nigredo", "aut" and the opening words of the Rubor paragraph are judged from the scan. The text continues on the next page after "tio-".
